artists.biography: The Magpie Salute is an exciting new band that features musicians who have played together for decades throughout various projects and share a musical bond. The band brings Rich Robinson, the guitarist and co-founding member of The Black Crowes, together with two key members of Crowes fame - guitarist Marc Ford and bassist Sven Pipien - alongside drummer Joe Magistro and guitarist Nico Bereciartua. The Magpie Salute also boasts a fine cast of vocalists, including lead singer John Hogg (Hookah Brown, Moke), former Crowes singer Charity White and background singers, Adrien Reju and Katrine Ottosen.

perplexity.description:
High Water II is the second studio album by American rock band The Magpie Salute, released on October 18, 2019, through Provogue Records. The album continues the band’s blend of Southern rock, blues, and classic rock, showcasing the signature guitar-driven sound of founding members Rich Robinson and Marc Ford, both formerly of The Black Crowes. With John Hogg on vocals, Sven Pipien on bass, Joe Magistro on drums, and Matt Slocum on keyboards, the album features a warm, analog-inspired production that highlights the group’s tight musicianship and soulful songwriting. Guest appearances, including Alison Krauss on vocals and fiddle, add further depth to the record’s rich sonic palette.

Musically, High Water II is often regarded as a companion piece to its predecessor, High Water I (2018), with both albums intended to be experienced as a cohesive project. The album’s tracks range from energetic rockers to introspective ballads, reflecting the band’s live energy and studio craftsmanship. Critics noted its strong performances and authentic sound, with Metacritic assigning it a score of 74/100 based on professional reviews. Commercially, the album reached number 1 on the UK Jazz & Blues Albums chart and entered several other national charts, including the US Heatseekers Albums chart. High Water II stands as a significant release in The Magpie Salute’s discography, capturing the band’s collaborative spirit and musical legacy.
